title: Final project manuscript
outcome: Explain final project manuscript using the records and boundaries of this fictional investigation.
scenario: Build a manuscript from claim to record. A capstone manuscript compares two frozen pattern classifiers on ten reserved cases.
given: A is correct on 7/10; B on 8/10. All cases are indoor, from five plants with two views each.

steps.label: State bounded claim
steps.detail: B adds one correct photo on this indoor set.

steps.label: Describe dependence
steps.detail: Ten photos come from five plants; report the grouping.

steps.label: Present results
steps.detail: Show 70% and 80% with counts and case-level outcomes.

steps.label: Preserve limitations
steps.detail: Do not claim outdoor robustness or ten independent plants.

explanation: A final manuscript aligns question, procedure, evidence and scope. Every figure and conclusion should point back to the records that support it.

counterfactual.change: The abstract calls the study a test on ten independent plants.
counterfactual.prediction: Correct it to five plants with two views each.
counterfactual.reason: The source-object count, not the photo count, defines the independent plants.

student_task: Connect the manuscript’s 7/10 and 8/10 scores to the five-plant grouping. Which abstract claim must be corrected if it says ten independent plants?
teacher_answer: B adds one correct photo on this indoor set. Ten photos come from five plants; report the grouping. Show 70% and 80% with counts and case-level outcomes. Do not claim outdoor robustness or ten independent plants. Changed case: Correct it to five plants with two views each. The source-object count, not the photo count, defines the independent plants.
project_evidence: For the Reproducible AI Research Study, retain an annotated worked trace and the changed-case reasoning. Connect the claim to its records, units and assumptions so another investigator can challenge or reproduce it.
limits: No population superiority or significance claim is supplied; dependence and sample coverage need explicit treatment.
review_note: Individually authored fictional practice distinct from the reserved independent case. No invented significance, real experiment execution or pupil outcome is asserted.

mini_visual.title: Indoor capstone photo outcomes
mini_visual.unit: correct photos out of 10; five plants
